messages:
mike-ops: Quick heads up — during the v2 rollout in eu-west we got a handful of mobile client errors. 502s and parse errors.
elaine-eng: seeing same in logs, looks like some clients failing on a response header we normalized (x-client-signal -> X-Client-Signal). Mobile SDK lowercased header parsing? :thinking_face:
thomas-sdks: Ugh, some Android clients use getHeaderCaseSensitive() workaround. Most servers treat headers case-insensitively per RFC but a few SDKs are strict.
sarah-product: are these from a single customer or spread out? any impact to rate-limited routes?
mike-ops: spread across three customers, mostly mobile 1.2.* builds. Traffic small but error rate spike after the v2 header normalization change at 2294999800 deploy.
elaine-eng: timeline: we changed header name normalization in v2 runtime to canonical-case headers to make routing rules consistent. It affects cache-keying and some downstream matchers. Change was in the v2 header middleware.
thomas-sdks: We can release a quick patch to SDK to accept both header cases, but customers on pinned older SDKs won't get it. Suggest a server-side mitigation.
elaine-eng: Mitigation options: 1) revert normalization (risky, affects caching), 2) add compatibility shim that sets both header keys in responses, or 3) per-client routing to v1 when we detect strict clients. Thoughts?
mike-ops: Can we detect strict clients from User-Agent? mobile/1.2.* seems consistent.
sarah-product: customer impact matters. If we can do transparent shim that's safest for users. Also prod notes need update and we should flag in release notes and postmortem.
elaine-eng: I'll push a compatibility shim to set both X-Client-Signal and x-client-signal on the response, and add a flag to toggle it per-route. Will roll it to canary then global if green.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Started rollback protection check for canary group 'v2-eu-west' — no increased 5xx observed in first 5m after shim deploy.
mike-ops: Good, keep an eye for duplicate headers downstream (some proxies might collapse).
thomas-sdks: We'll ship SDK patch to accept both header cases and call out the server shim in the release notes. I'll prepare a migration note for mobile engineers.
sarah-product: Add an item to release notes: "Temporary header compatibility shim for mobile 1.2.* to address parsing errors; SDK patch forthcoming."
elaine-eng: Timeline: pushing shim now to canary (2295001300), monitor 30m, then promote. If any regressions, we'll fall back to header revert and open hotfix.
mike-ops: Logging check: add a metric for header-mismatch hits (requests where client only sees lowercase header).
thomas-sdks: Also include a sample code snippet for mobile devs: `String h = response.getHeader("X-Client-Signal"); if (h == null) h = response.getHeader("x-client-signal");`
sarah-product: I'll coordinate customer comms for the three affected accounts and add to customer-facing incident doc.
elaine-eng: canary looks clean at +18m, no new parse errors. Proceeding to promote to global in 10m.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion to global started for 'v2-header-compat-shim' at 2295001400.
mike-ops: Monitoring dashboard green, latency unchanged. Good job team. :thumbsup:
thomas-sdks: After global, we'll ship SDK patch and update the changelog. Then remove shim in next major once clients upgrade.
sarah-product: Plan noted. Postmortem template ready, assign to eng-runbook owner for follow-up.
elaine-eng: Filing follow-up PR to add automated tests for header canonicalization behavior in the runtime.
mike-ops: Closing thread once postmortem and release note entries are merged. Thanks all. :pray:
